links.rationale: The owner describes Ozmo washing exterior glazing from a building-integrated access system under rooftop supervision.
limitations: Requires a compatible BMU, engineered installation and trained operator.
US deployment does not establish German availability, weather limits or complete facade coverage.

links.rationale: Manufacturer describes suction lifting and positioning of glass units for installation.
limitations: Covers lifting and positioning only; glazing blocks, beads, fixings and seals remain separate.
Use the exact load chart, suction-contact requirements and site access plan; headline capacity is not full-reach capacity.
